glossary.definition: (A) "Parental rights" means parental rights and responsibilities, parenting time, or any other similar right established by the laws of this state with respect to a child. "Parental rights" does not include the parental duty of support for a child.

glossary.definition: (B) "Rape" means a violation of section 2907.02 of the Revised Code or similar law of another state.
